site.context: Lake Mackay WA playa brine (East Pilbara–adjacent / Gibson Desert); not Port Hedland seawater; not a mining lease

meta.quality: Agrimin Mackay Potash Project EPA water-chemistry memo median lake groundwater majors (Na, Cl, Mg, K, SO4). Ca/Li/Br not pinned as medians in our sources — omitted. Not a mining-lease sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses converted from tabulated mg/L to g/kg with density 1.16 kg/L (screening from ~215 g/L TDS band — not a CTD). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited median ions, not the TDS headline. Agrimin/Global Resources ASX MRE is K/Mg/SO4 corroboration only. Not Port Hedland seawater; literature assay is not a mineral concession.
